Would you like to help define how people interact with intelligence in spatial computing? Join the team that brings Siri and Visual Intelligence to Apple Vision Pro and visionOS. We build the platform software that enables Siri and lets users learn about the objects and places around them. We are a highly collaborative team working closely with the broader Siri, Visual Intelligence, and Vision Products teams. If you enjoy deep systems problems, care about the details of the user experience, and want to see your work ship on Apple’s newest platforms, we want to hear from you.
As a Software Engineer on our team, you will design, build, and ship the software that integrates Siri and Visual Intelligence into visionOS. You will work across the stack - from invocation, audio, and camera pipelines through on-device AI/ML integration to the system experiences that present results in a person’s surroundings. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will partner with the broader Siri, Visual Intelligence, visionOS, design, privacy, and performance teams across Apple to define and deliver these experiences to our users. You will move quickly to prototype and prove out new ideas, then turn them into reliable, production-quality systems that meet demanding latency, power, and performance goals.
Design, implement, and ship Siri and Visual Intelligence platform features for visionOS
Build and evolve the infrastructure that connects Siri, Apple Intelligence, and system experiences on visionOS
Prototype early-stage concepts to validate feasibility and help shape product direction
Adapt and design new features for vision products
Debug complex issues spanning multiple processes, frameworks, and devices
Partner with design, product, and cross-functional engineering teams from concept through launch
Contribute to architecture decisions, design reviews, and code reviews
Minimum Qualifications
BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
5+ years of professional software development experience
Strong agentic programming skills and experience in Swift, Objective-C, or C++
Solid understanding of data structures, memory management, and concurrency
Experience building and debugging system software, frameworks, or large production codebases
Enjoys working collaboratively across engineering, design, and product teams
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and changing priorities
Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing for visionOS, iOS, or macOS using Apple system frameworks
Experience with intelligent assistants, conversational AI, or voice-driven systems
Experience with computer vision, camera or sensor pipelines, or real-time perception
Experience integrating ML models for on-device inference, including evaluation and performance optimization
Experience with spatial computing or AR/VR technologies such as RealityKit and ARKit
Experience optimizing power and performance on resource-constrained or real-time systems
Track record of shipping user-facing features at scale
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in daily engineering work

If you are passionate about pushing the limits of technology to bring delight to a large user base, we want you to join our team. We are looking for a highly self-motivated and collaborative software engineer to work on prototyping, integration, and productization of software that combines computer vision, 3D computer graphics, machine learning models, camera and/other sensor data. Together we'll ship exciting new technologies and experiences for Apple's current and next generation products. Are you ready to be a part of the next big thing at Apple?
Rapidly designing, building and iterating on end-to-end functional prototypes that explore new concepts and interface with cameras and other sensors. Collaborating closely with Human Interface designers, ML researchers, and cross-functional teams to define and achieve project goals. Prototyping polished, intuitive user interfaces — at a quality level suitable for executive review.

Experience developing high-performance software for mobile devices using Swift, SwiftUI, and/or Objective-C.

5 or more years of software engineering experience with the technical concepts listed in the minimum qualifications.
Ability to learn quickly, adapt, and innovate as requirements evolve during prototyping and integration.
Experience with SLAM, VIO, or 3D Augmented Reality frameworks such as Reality Kit.
Experience with GPU programming and the testing, integration, and deployment of Machine Learning models.
Familiarity in Python for Machine Learning research prototypes, with experience porting to real-time mobile systems being a plus.
Experience developing high-performance software for mobile devices using C++.
Experience with iOS and/or macOS app development using Swift, SwiftUI, and Metal in Xcode.
Fluency using AI coding assistants for tasks such as rapid prototyping, while maintaining oversight and responsibility for generated code.
Detail-oriented and organized, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

apple-200689632-3337.text:
The Apple Services Engineering Security team builds and provides secure systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple’s services (such as iCloud, iTunes, Siri, App Store, and Maps). As part of the ASE Security team, you will help manage the security needs of Apple’s services around the world. You will build and integrate the security controls, guardrails, and frameworks that help protect our customers data in Apple’s infrastructure. Your work will help build solutions to a variety of outstanding security risks to Apple systems and data. Join us, and you’ll play a meaningful role in ensuring the highest standard of security for one of the most-watched companies in the world.
In this role, you will be the primary security team point of contact for several large engineering efforts. You will work with engineering teams throughout their development lifecycle. You will conduct security reviews, post incident reviews, develop threat models, and use the insights from these engagements to build scalable methodologies. You will help define, automate and advocate for application level and platform-wide security improvements with a focus on risks to customer accounts and data. You will play a hands on role in ensuring that programs are reviewed, adjusted, implemented and tested appropriately.
Identify areas for improvement related to user account security and establish appropriate security goals
Lead discovery conversations to understand architecture, current security posture, and blockers to adoption
Measure and communicate risks to leaders and stakeholders
Develop and implement AI technologies to manage risk
Perform post-incident reviews and investigations
Research and identify emerging technologies, threats, and vulnerabilities to proactively define security requirements and controls before they reach production
Partner with teams to improve the security of their services and systems.
Minimum Qualifications
7 or more years conducting security reviews, incident response, threat modeling, or security engineering
Demonstrated ability to design, document, and implement new security processes
Understanding of cloud-native architecture and managed platform service (eg. compute, storage, networking, databases)
Expertise in threat modeling, operational threat intelligence, and common attack vectors and frameworks.
Understanding of applied cryptography, access control, modern authentication frameworks, and other security mechanisms
Experience with enterprise log collection and analysis platforms (e.g., Splunk, OSQuery)
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with threat hunting, insider risk and/or investigations
Experience working with data engineers to define metrics and interpret results from detection and risk models
Experience in applying and experimenting with AI/ML, to solve security related use-cases

Our team tests and builds platforms behind the fraud detection, data and machine-learning systems of Apple Pay, Wallet and other Apple services. That covers ML tooling and model evaluation, data validation, and On-Device Insight (ODI), the on-device risk signals behind fraud decisions. Our work makes sure models, signals and data are right before they reach customers, so Apple can stop fraud without adding friction or compromising privacy.
We are growing the team to support a major new Apple Pay feature and the growth of our ML and data platforms. This role designs, builds and runs the iOS frameworks, data tools and self-service platform that engineering and data science teams use to build, check and ship on-device risk signals. Product mindset that starts with the problem and user needs
Scalable system design and architecture
Track record of building services, tools or platforms with real-world adoption
Ability to find solutions where no approach exists yet
Resilient, self-driven and quick to learn complex systems

Experience with XCTest and automation frameworks

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple's customers every single day.
We are looking for an embedded engineer at heart who is just as comfortable in the higher layers of the stack. You are happiest when you are bringing up a new board, reading a datasheet, and chasing a bug with a scope and a debugger. You also know that a working system needs more than firmware: host-side software, tooling, automation, and data flow. You will write low-level code in C and the surrounding software in Python and C++, and you will connect the two. You are not a specialist in one layer. You are the person who learns whatever the problem requires, integrates the hardware and software that need to work together, and delivers a working solution end to end.
Develop embedded software and firmware in C for custom hardware, including drivers, peripheral interfaces, and communication protocols.
Bring up new hardware platforms and debug across the hardware/software boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
Build the host-side software that talks to embedded targets: tools, libraries, test automation, and data-collection software in Python and C++.
Integrate diverse systems, devices, sensors, and tools, including ones that were never designed to work together.
Build and maintain automated hardware-in-the-loop test and CI infrastructure.
Make advanced AI coding tools a core part of how you build and help set the standard for how a small team moves fast with them.
Participate in design and code reviews, and write clear, maintainable, well-documented code.
Minimum Qualifications
BS or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency in C with strong embedded software experience, including work close to the hardware (microcontrollers, drivers, or board bring-up).
Working knowledge of Python and C++ for tooling, test automation, and host-side software.
Experience with common hardware interfaces and protocols (e.g., SPI, I2C, UART, USB).
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code, including embedded or firmware-adjacent systems.
Experience with RTOS or bare-metal development on ARM Cortex-M/A platforms (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), and with low-latency or timing-critical code.
Experience with embedded Linux, kernel drivers, or cross-compilation toolchains and build systems.
Experience with sensors, signal acquisition, or DSP, and with wireless protocols such as BLE.
Experience developing host-side applications on macOS or iOS (Swift or Objective-C).
Experience building hardware-in-the-loop test systems, CI/CD, and automated validation.
Background in startups, research environments, or small teams.
Fluent with git and modern development workflows (testing, code review).

More than a billion people trust Photos with their most important memories. The Photos QA team keeps that experience reliable, fast, and polished across every Apple platform and iCloud. Every release depends on detailed, judgment-heavy work, triaging bugs, assessing risk, planning coverage, and qualifying builds. We’re looking for a software engineer to build the tools and agentic AI systems for quality engineering that make that work faster and more consistent, without sacrificing accuracy.
This role focuses on designing, building, and integrating the tools that support the Photos QA team's work across automation, triage, test planning, and release qualification. You will balance hands-on engineering with close collaboration, working alongside QA and software engineers to understand their workflows and prioritize what to build. Once a tool is in use, you will help the team adopt it and keep improving it based on their feedback.
Partner with Photos development engineering, quality integrity and engineering, and program management to identify where better tooling will have the most impact
Design, build, and maintain tools, dashboards, and workflows, including AI-powered ones, that support automation triage, test plan generation, coverage gap analysis, and build qualification
Design and build agentic AI systems that reason across multiple tools and data sources, such as bug tracking, build pipelines, and test management systems, to complete multi-step QA tasks with minimal human intervention
Design and implement tools that navigate complex, multi-platform architecture flows across iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and iCloud backend services, with visibility into cross-platform dependencies and failure modes
Connect large local or external models to bug tracking systems, sw build pipelines, and test management systems using structured tool calling, MCP/plugins, and scheduled or event-driven workflows
Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, and regression suites that measure the accuracy and consistency of AI-generated output and flag failures clearly
Build tools that set photo libraries on test devices to known, reproducible states and capture diagnostics such as memory graphs and logs
Integrate automation and AI tools into CI/CD pipelines, nightly runs, and release qualification
Document and package tools as reusable workflows, and train QA engineers to adopt them
Minimum Qualifications
Industry experience in software development, test automation, or tools engineering
Proficiency in Swift or Python, with a track record of building tools and frameworks used by others
Experience using AI/LLMs to improve your own workflow or build AI-assisted tooling, with the ability to critically review and debug AI-generated output
Strong understanding of quality engineering: test design, coverage strategy, flakiness reduction, root-cause analysis
Experience integrating tools and automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency in both Swift and Python
Experience with multi-agent systems or orchestrating complex AI workflows with tool-using capabilities
Understanding of distributed systems and multi-platform architecture testing
Experience designing evaluations for AI systems
Experience with scheduled or event-driven automation, such as cron jobs or webhooks
Experience with UI automation using XCTest or XCUITest
Experience driving adoption of new tools across a team or organization
Demonstrated ability to manage your own priorities and drive projects with minimal direction
Familiarity with the Photos app and Apple’s media ecosystem

The Siri team is redefining how hundreds of millions of people access information across Apple devices, with privacy built in from the ground up. As part of the Agentic Search Evaluation team, you will help advance Apple Intelligence through personalized search, result ranking, and low-latency production services that power experiences across Siri, Spotlight, Safari, Messages, and more. Your team researches and builds deep search systems for Personal Question Answering, enabling Siri to answer questions about a user's emails, messages, events, files, and more, while keeping personal data private.
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Manager with a passion for building scalable, high-quality solutions to evaluate personalized search applications. In this role, you will directly shape how Apple assesses and improves the quality of Agentic Search — driving solutions across search quality, data quality, and both offline and online metrics to enable iterative product improvements. You will lead a team focused on evaluating Agentic Search experiences that power personalized Siri AI and enable answers to users' personal questions, with privacy at the forefront. Your team designs and builds evaluation systems, develops data generation and curation methods, and creates metrics frameworks for quality assessment and continuous improvement.
Lead a team of applied machine learning and software engineers to design and build scalable, automated systems for end-to-end evaluation of personalized Agentic Search
Contribute to the design and implementation of offline and online metrics to assess quality at the product and component level for Personal Question Answering, and drive iterative improvement
Collaborate with partner teams to define data and evaluation requirements, set priorities, and identify opportunities to enhance the Personal Question Answering stack
Define the long-term technical vision for personalized Siri Search quality, identify gaps, and drive solutions as part of a broader roadmap
Minimum Qualifications
6 or more years of industry experience building machine learning or machine learning evaluation systems at scale
2 or more years of industry experience in technical leadership or management
Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, neural network architectures, and software engineering in Python or C/C++
Communication and collaboration skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing and building production machine learning systems in search, natural language processing, recommendation systems, or information retrieval
Experience in data collection, data generation, or data quality assessment of language, image, or multimodal data
Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience

Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.
The Vision Products Group (VPG) is looking for a Senior Graphics Software Engineer to help us push the limits of the next generation of interactive experiences on our platform. This team is working with some of Apple’s most advanced technologies including spatial computing, augmented reality, ARKit and Metal, to create ground-breaking new products. As a member of our creative organization, you will have the uniquely rewarding opportunity to craft future products that will delight and inspire millions of people every single day.
As a Senior Graphics Software Engineer, you’ll work with the newest technologies to bring Apple Vision Pro Environments to life. Environments give people an immersive space to work, watch, and play. People spend hours immersed under the auroras of Thórsmörk or sitting on the beach in Bora Bora, so every detail has to look convincingly real and every environment has to run efficiently to preserve battery life and keep the apps customers use running smoothly.
You’ll develop the system-level frameworks and real-time rendering techniques that make these places believable, from physically based materials to dynamic image-based lighting. You’ll write high-performance shaders, create RealityKit-based systems to drive effects, and profile each technique to analyze its GPU cost. You’ll use agentic workflows to iterate faster on development and optimization.
You’ll work closely with designers and technical artists across Apple and VPG, building the tools and pipelines that enable pre-visualization, optimization, and fine-tuning. You’ll partner with the teams that own the rendering engine and system-level frameworks to implement solutions and debug problems that cross the software stack. You work quickly and smartly to help determine the viability of new ideas and technologies. You bring a keen understanding of GPUs and lower-level programming. You have the ambition and curiosity to improve, innovate, and explore to bring surprise and delight to Apple customers.
Develop high-quality, real-time rendering techniques for immersive experiences
Partner with designers and technical artists to turn creative intent into production quality rendering features
Profile, analyze, and optimize rendering systems and 3D source content, focusing on power efficiency and performance, GPU and CPU utilization, memory footprint, and power consumption
Drive technical direction through R&D work, design documents, and code reviews
Build and extend artist tools for asset optimization and profiling
Mentor engineers and uphold high engineering standards across the team
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of professional experience in real-time graphics or rendering engine development
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience shipping high-quality GPU shaders and significant rendering features end to end
Proficiency in C++ and shader programming languages (Metal Shading Language, GLSL, or HLSL)
Proficient in mathematics for 3D real-time applications
Solid understanding of color science, human visual perception, texture sampling, compression, filtering, and of GPU memory management and frame pacing
Experience debugging complex rendering issues across multiple layers of the software stack
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive alignment across multiple partner teams
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, or related field
Experience architecting and leading teams to build complex rendering systems
Understanding of Apple GPU architecture (tile-based deferred rendering)
Experience writing optimized code using profiling tools, assembly, SIMD, etc.
Experience reading and optimizing GPU intermediate representation formats
Experience using agentic iteration for rendering optimization

At Apple, individual creativity converges around shared values that drive innovation. Our CV/ML team works where perception, intelligence, and real-time processing meet. We have shipped Optic ID, Apple Vision Pro's biometric authentication, along with Eye Tracking and other computer vision features. We are looking for an experienced CV/ML engineer who runs rigorous experiments, shapes the data behind them, and brings modern deep learning architectures to products used by millions of people.
Ready to make an impact?
You will take on complex problems in understanding people from camera and sensor data, and you will own these problems from hypothesis to shipped model. You will shape experiments and what success looks like, and you will bring new methods where the established ones fall short. You know that model quality starts with the data: you find gaps and imbalances in it and work with partner teams to get the data that's missing. You will represent your area to hardware, software, and UX teams and adapt recent architectures for efficient on-device use.
Design, execute, and analyze ML experiments with sound baselines, metrics, and statistical rigor; help define evaluation/success criteria.
Assess datasets for coverage, quality, and bias; balance and curate them; define and drive data collection and annotation requests with partner teams.
Prototype and adapt modern ML network architectures.
Design model training optimized for real-world problems; train the models to meet state-of-the-art performance.
Build evaluation and failure analysis that reflect real-world use, including robustness and fairness across users and conditions.
Optimize models for on-device compute, memory, and latency budgets.
Represent the team cross-functionally and clearly communicate progress, impact, and trade-offs.
Mentor engineers within the team.
Minimum Qualifications
B.S. and minimum 10 years of industry experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision or related field.
Hands-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for vision.
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch.
Track record of designing experiments and drawing sound conclusions.
Preferred Qualifications
M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Vision or related field.
Experience in face or eye analysis or biometrics: detection, landmarks, tracking, gaze estimation, or recognition.
Experience curating large datasets and specifying data collection, including synthetic data.
Strong foundations in linear algebra, probability, and optimization.
Familiarity with optimizing models for deployment.
Experience shipping ML in consumer products, publishing at top-tier CV/ML conferences, or holding patents.
Expertise across multiple technical areas, solving cross-disciplinary challenges, and explaining the end-to-end system.
Track record of independently driving significant, ambiguous problems to resolution, with cross-functional impact, and setting technical direction with management and beyond.
Experience mentoring beyond your own team and communicating with senior leadership.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a curiosity for hard problems.

apple-200696349-0157.text:
Join Apple’s Hardware group and help develop innovative solutions that drive the seamless integration of hardware and software. In this role, you will contribute to building the technology that powers Apple’s products—ensuring they deliver the performance, reliability, and user experience loved by millions around the world. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware and software, solving complex challenges in a highly collaborative and uniquely Apple environment.
In this role, you will develop the tools and flows for managing a single, authoritative description of the hardware/software interface. This includes capturing new architectural requirements from Apple's hardware designs in the common description format and its compiler, ensuring every generated output reflects them correctly, and keeping hardware interface data flowing continuously to software teams for all Apple hardware projects.
This visible and cross-functional role also covers services that make this data accessible across the organization: tracking, searching, browsing, and comparing interface descriptions across projects and releases. The work is full-stack, from low-level C++ development to hosted web services and client user interfaces. It's a close partnership with the designers and software engineers who rely on these tools every day.
Collaborating with internal hardware design teams and the broader software organization to enable co-development and integration.
Defining and evolving an IP-XACT-compatible register description format.
Designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable, and intelligent HW/SW interface tools and infrastructure.
Automating data exchange pipelines to enhance collaboration within Apple and with external vendors.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
Experience in C++ and Python programming
Experience with git, perforce, or other version control systems
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of relevant industry experience
Knowledge of hardware development fundamentals and chip design concepts
Experience with IP-XACT, SystemRDL, or other hardware register description standards
Comfortable developing in macOS and Linux environments
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build systems (GitLab CI, TeamCity, etc.)
Proven ability to work collaboratively across hardware and software teams
Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical and architectural concepts
Understanding of RTL development and design verification methodologies
